description: This file contains auto-generated C++ class definitions for various BML (Backhaul Management Layer) action messages within the beerocks framework. These classes encapsulate request and response messages related to network topology, channel management, Wi-Fi credentials, client steering, and other network control actions, and are designed to facilitate serialization, deserialization, and interaction with the beerocks messaging system.

classes.name: cACTION_BML_PING_REQUEST

classes.name: cACTION_BML_PING_RESPONSE
classes.description: Represents a ping response message. Facilitates conversion to and from wire format with overridden class_swap and finalize.
